content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Lab Technician: B.Sc. (Microbiology / Biotechnology) with DMLT/equivalent from recognized university/ Institute/ State Board of Technical Education. Candidates with Bachelor’s degree in Medical Laboratory Technology are also eligible. One Year Experience in diagnostic Laboratory is preferred.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 30 years Age relaxation will be as per government rules. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: TMC ACTREC Lab Technician Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC ACTREC Lab Technician Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Lab Technician.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for Lab Technician?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the Lab Technician post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview date is 21 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Lab Technician post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is B.Sc. (Microbiology / Biotechnology) with DMLT/equivalent or Bachelor’s degree in Medical Laboratory Technology.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the Lab Technician post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Lab Technician position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 26,210 to 32,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Lab Technician role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview venue is at Advanced Centre for Treatment Research and Education in Cancer (TMC ACTREC), Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, Pincode: 410210.
